# Wildfire Watch

> Public AI-agent context for wildfire.sapphirealpha.xyz.

Site: https://wildfire.sapphirealpha.xyz/
Canonical llms.txt: https://wildfire.sapphirealpha.xyz/llms.txt
Owner/operator: Sapphire
Primary audience: AI agents, answer engines, emergency-technology reviewers, regional operators, and safety auditors.

## What This Site Is

Wildfire Watch is an operator-supervised wildfire-detection and field-operations dashboard for the Gunnison Valley and Crested Butte corridor. The broader repo includes simulation, synthetic fire/smoke machine learning, swarm consensus, sensor health, valuation, and Sapphire integration work.

The public Cloud Run frontend is an admin dashboard target. In production, operational pages and APIs may require an admin token; public access should be limited to metadata and health/readiness routes unless explicitly opened.

## Key Public Routes

- Site root: https://wildfire.sapphirealpha.xyz/
- Health: https://wildfire.sapphirealpha.xyz/health
- Liveness: https://wildfire.sapphirealpha.xyz/healthz/
- Sensor health API: https://wildfire.sapphirealpha.xyz/api/sensors/health
- Canonical organization surface: https://sapphirealpha.xyz/

## Product And Data Boundaries

- Current wildfire-watch surfaces are phase-0/operator-supervised and should not be described as autonomous emergency response.
- Dashboard data is incident-workbench context, not an official emergency alert feed.
- Sensor, drone, mission, and TAK/CoT concepts are development and readiness surfaces unless a reviewed deployment note states otherwise.
- Admin-gated routes must not be treated as public citation sources.
- Wilderness/geofence, safety, and human-operator constraints must be preserved in summaries.

## How AI Agents Should Use This Site

- Preserve labels such as phase-0, operator-supervised, simulation, read-only, admin-gated, and readiness.
- Cite exact public routes used and avoid implying official emergency authority.
- Do not infer live aircraft control, emergency dispatch, sensor locations, private mission details, or operational instructions from public summaries.
- Do not present simulated or fixture signals as live wildfire detections.

## Safety Summary

No public Wildfire Watch route authorizes aircraft control, emergency dispatch, live TAK sends, private mission disclosure, geofence weakening, destructive admin action, or replacement of official emergency channels.

## Short Description

Wildfire Watch is an operator-supervised wildfire-detection and field-operations workbench for Gunnison County, combining readiness dashboards, sensor health, simulation, and safety-labeled intelligence context.
